name: compute_site
description: A place work may actually run, and the widest class of data it is cleared to see. Placement is asked per backend because the answer differs per backend: the machine holding the data may run only the reference implementation, and the machine holding the reducers may not be cleared to receive the input. A site row is a declaration by this estate about a machine, never a discovery about one -- a site that is unreachable is still declared, and a site absent from this table places nothing, which is why a missing declaration reads as 'no backend may run' rather than as 'run it anywhere'. holds_live_data says the site carries state that an outage would lose; max_data_scope is the widest data class it may receive, and a job whose scope exceeds it is not placed there however idle it is.
